title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Account Agreement Schedule — Inactivity, Closure Balance and Credit Balance Refund
content:
The closure and credit balance terms of a Ridgeline Pro Credit account are those of its tier.

| Tier | Months with no purchase and no payment before inactivity closure | Closure waits for a zero balance | Credit balance above which a refund may be asked (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Pro Revolving Charge | 24 | No | 1.00 |
| Ridgeline Pro Revolving Charge Plus | 24 | No | 1.00 |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 30 | 24 | Yes | 10.00 |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 30 Select | 36 | Yes | 10.00 |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 45 | 36 | Yes | 10.00 |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 60 Enterprise | 36 | Yes | 10.00 |

## Meaning of the columns

- **Inactivity closure months**: the months with no purchase and no payment after which Commercial Credit may close the account.
- **Closure waits for a zero balance**: "Yes" means a closure request takes effect only once the balance is 0.00; "No" means it takes effect immediately, with the balance repaid under the existing terms.
- **Credit balance refund threshold**: the business may ask for a refund of a credit balance above this figure. Hypothetically, on a Commercial Account Net 30 a credit balance of 10.00 is not above the threshold, while one of 10.01 is.
